title: Ada bar Rabbi
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned at the end of Peah 6:1, according to the Raavad’s reading cited in his commentary on Eduyot 4:3. Hyman says that he asked Rabbi Shimon ben Lakish. Hyman’s own text reads “one of the rabbinic students.”

notes.text: The Eduyot mishnah marker מ״נ remains unresolved in the supplied source.

The saved whole Vilna Raavad commentary on Mishnah Eduyot 4:3:2 explicitly quotes Ada beRabbi אמר קומי ריש לקיש, “said before Resh Lakish.” This supplies a matching commentary location alongside source מ״נ, without proving a nun/gimel error. Hyman’s “asked” and his contrast with “one of the rabbinic students” are preserved; the named text’s wording is recorded separately.

Hyman’s print (vol. I, p. 105) reads Eduyot 4:3 (מ״ג), where the supplied text has מ״נ. The consulted Raavad on Eduyot 4:3 quotes Ada bar Rabbi as having spoken before Resh Lakish. In the consulted Jerusalem Talmud Peah 6:1, the speaker is an unnamed student (חד בר בי רב), who reports a statement of Rabbi Yochanan before Rabbi Shimon ben Lakish. Hyman gives his reading as חד בר רבנן.
